title: Learning to Solve Stochastic Controls with Unknown Drifts and Running Rewards: Theory, Algorithms and Convergence
abstract: arXiv:2609.14972v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study continuous-time and possibly high-dimensional stochastic control problems where drift coefficients and running reward functions are unknown. Due to these missing model primitives, we take the exploratory, reinforcement learning (RL) framework of Wang, Zariphopoulou, and Zhou(2020) with relaxed controls and entropy regularization. The objective is to develop theoretically grounded, efficient and scalable RL algorithms to learn both the optimal value functions (which also solve the exploratory HJB equation) and optimal exploratory feedback control policies. When the diffusion coefficients do not contain control, we employ probabilistic representations of both the optimal value function and its gradient based on an auxiliary state process depending only on the diffusion part of the original dynamics. translated_title: 学习求解具有未知漂移项和运行奖励的随机控制问题：理论、算法与收敛性
translated_abstract: 我们研究连续时间且可能是高维的随机控制问题，其中漂移系数和运行奖励函数是未知的。由于这些模型基本要素的缺失，我们采用Wang、Zariphopoulou和Zhou（2020）提出的探索性强化学习（RL）框架，并结合松弛控制和熵正则化。目标是开发有理论基础、高效且可扩展的强化学习算法，以学习最优价值函数（该函数同时也求解探索性HJB方程）和最优探索性反馈控制策略。当扩散系数不包含控制项时，我们基于一个仅依赖于原动力系统扩散部分的辅助状态过程，采用最优价值函数及其梯度的概率表示。通过对一些恰当定义的映射及其不动点的细致分析，这引出了我们策略迭代算法的引入……
tldr: 针对漂移系数和运行奖励未知的连续时间高维随机控制问题，本文基于探索性强化学习框架，利用概率表示与不动点分析，提出了学习最优价值函数和探索性反馈控制策略的策略迭代算法，并给出其收敛性理论保证。
en_tdlr: For continuous-time, possibly high-dimensional stochastic control problems with unknown drift coefficients and running rewards, this paper develops theoretically grounded and scalable policy iteration RL algorithms—using probabilistic representations and fixed-point analysis—to learn optimal value functions and exploratory feedback control policies with convergence guarantees.
